parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no structural evidence whatsoever: differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, and shared_field_count are all null, and the members array is empty. Without field lists, method lists, or a Jaccard similarity score, there is no grounded basis on which to recommend a refactor between Announcement (_Plant_Announcement.swift:13) and Playcut (PlaylistEntry.swift:160). The cluster_id encodes a subset-pairs signal, but the pipeline failed to populate the supporting data needed to evaluate whether the overlap is meaningful or merely coincidental naming within the same Playlist package.
